_comment: Recraft logo prompt templates. Edit strings here; variable substitution happens at runtime. Available variables: {subject}, {brand}, {colors}, {bg}, {SHAPE} (uppercase), {Shape} (ucfirst), {enclosure} ('Subject' or 'Logo and text').

default_colors.fantasy: emerald green, antique gold, deep crimson
default_colors.future: neon cyan, electric purple, deep black

shape_block: PRIMARY: PERFECT {SHAPE} container is dominant. {enclosure} fully enclosed inside. Must remain outermost shape.

style_line.medium: Style: High fantasy logo, Lord of the Rings inspired, ornate.
style_line.max: Style: High fantasy illustration, Lord of the Rings inspired, rich detail, painterly textures, ornate.

with_shape.primary: PRIMARY: PERFECT {SHAPE} outermost boundary. {enclosure} fully enclosed inside. Nothing outside.

subject_icon.medium: Subject: {subject} with fine detail and mythical presence.
subject_icon.max: Subject: {subject} with ornate detail, intricate linework, mythical presence.

subject_text.max: Subject: {subject} with ornate medieval serif text "{brand}".

detail.medium: Scrollwork, rune accents, enchanted forest motifs.
detail.max: Elven scrollwork, ancient runes, mythical textures.

background.max: Background: {bg}. Completely empty outside the {Shape}. Isolated emblem, no backdrop, no environment, no scenery.

subject_icon.medium: Subject: {subject}. Fantasy symbol with fine detail and mythical presence.
subject_icon.max: Subject: {subject}. Detailed fantasy creature or symbol, intricate linework, fine detail, mythical presence.

subject_text.medium: Subject: {subject} with "{brand}" in ornate medieval serif with decorative flourishes.
subject_text.max: Subject: {subject} with "{brand}" in ornate medieval serif typeface with decorative flourishes.

detail.medium: Scrollwork, rune accents, enchanted forest motifs.
detail.max: Elven scrollwork, ancient runes, enchanted forest motifs, mythical textures, aged parchment feel.

colors.max: Colors: {colors}. Rich shading, metallic highlights, deep jewel tones.

quality.max: Epic, cinematic, high-detail. No flat fills. No minimalism.

style_line.medium: Style: Mythic cosmic fantasy logo, celestial, star-forged.
style_line.max: Style: Mythic cosmic fantasy logo, celestial, star-forged, ancient astral geometry.

subject_icon.medium: Subject: {subject}. Celestial symbol with astral energy and starborn details.
subject_icon.max: Subject: {subject}. Mythic celestial symbol, starborn geometry, astral energy, cosmic aether presence.

subject_text.min: Subject: {subject} with "{brand}" in mythic cosmic typeface.
subject_text.max: Subject: {subject} with "{brand}" in ornate celestial typeface, star-forged and ancient.

colors.max: Colors: {colors}. Celestial glow, nebula highlights, cosmic aether illumination.

future.quality: No earthly elements. Mythic cosmic atmosphere. Celestial geometry, astral presence, starborn scale.

style_line.medium: Style: Bold retro vintage logo, screen-print aesthetic.
style_line.max: Style: Bold retro vintage logo, screen-print aesthetic, limited palette.

subject_icon.medium: Subject: {subject}. Bold retro icon, strong outlines.
subject_icon.max: Subject: {subject}. Bold retro icon, strong outlines, vintage poster feel.

subject_text.max: Subject: {subject} with "{brand}" in a bold retro slab-serif.

colors.max: Colors: {colors}. Hard edges, flat fills, halftone textures.

retro.quality: No photorealism. No gradients. Classic American retro design.

minimalist.shape_quality: Single filled shape. No line-art. Thick shapes, smooth curves.

quality.medium: Single filled shape. No line-art. Thick shapes, smooth curves.
quality.max: Single filled shape. No line-art. Thick shapes, smooth curves. Negative space as cut-outs.

minimalist.flat_fills: Flat fills only. No gradients, shadows, glows, textures.

style_line.min: Style: Hand-painted watercolor greeting card illustration.
style_line.medium: Style: Hand-painted watercolor greeting card illustration. Soft color washes, visible paper grain.
style_line.max: Style: Hand-painted watercolor greeting card illustration. Soft washes, visible paper grain texture, uneven deckled edges.

subject_icon.medium: Subject: {subject}. Soft watercolor rendering with gentle painted edges.
subject_icon.max: Subject: {subject}. Soft watercolor rendering, painterly edges, delicate wet-on-wet blooms.

subject_text.max: Subject: {subject} with "{brand}" in elegant hand-lettered watercolor script with soft ink variation.

colors.max: Colors: {colors}. Muted pastel tones, soft translucent watercolor layering.

quality.min: High-quality gouache textures, dreamy lighting. No hard lines.
quality.max: High-quality gouache textures, dreamy soft lighting. No hard digital lines, no flat fills, no 3D renders.

greetingcard.text_brand: Text: "{brand}" in hand-lettered script only, no other text.
